title: Lost In Translation drops a new track "Every Storm"
htmlContent:
Lost In Translation's "Every Storm" is the perfect song to listen to and get away with your thoughts. It’s not only a good record, but music that creates an experience that you will crave to be apart of. If you need good music to get you thought, this record delivers in every way.

Lost In Translation will be consistently releasing highly relatable music for the rest of the year, and can be sure that all of them will take his fans through a world of emotions and motivation. The future is looking very bright for Lost In Translation.
